name: Screenshot
description: Capture the screen and keep a local screenshot history in DBX. Includes silent screen recording (MP4, no audio). Saving can copy images to the clipboard (overwrites current clipboard contents; toggle in settings). On Linux, region capture needs gnome-screenshot, spectacle, or scrot on PATH.
releaseNotes: 0.1.3: silent screen recording (MP4, no audio) with start/stop, FPS/clarity settings; ffmpeg recommended for muxing (OpenH264 fallback without it).

zh-CN.name: 截图
zh-CN.description: 截取屏幕并在 DBX 中保存本机截图历史，支持无声屏幕录制（MP4）。保存后可复制图片到剪贴板（会覆盖当前剪贴板内容，可在设置中关闭）。Linux 区域截图需系统已安装 gnome-screenshot、spectacle 或 scrot。
